items.source: Convenience variant of formatValue(Object, int, boolean) that limits the length of a log message to 100 characters and also replaces newline and control characters if limitLength is set to "true".
items.translation: `formatValue(Object, int, boolean)` 的便捷变体，将日志消息的长度限制为 100 个字符，并且如果 `limitLength` 设置为 "true"，还会替换换行符和控制字符。

items.source: Format the given value via toString(), quoting it if it is a CharSequence, truncating at the specified maxLength, and compacting it into a single line when replaceNewLines is set.
items.translation: 通过 `toString()` 格式化给定值，如果它是CharSequence则对其进行引用，在指定的 `maxLength`` 处截断，并在设置 `replaceNewLines`` 时将其压缩为单行。

items.source: messageFactory - function that accepts a boolean set to the value of Log.isTraceEnabled()
items.translation: messageFactory - 接受一个布尔值作为参数的函数，该布尔值设置为 Log.isTraceEnabled() 的值。

items.source: limitLength - whether to truncate the value at a length of 100
items.translation: limitLength - 是否将值截断为 100 个字符长度。

items.source: maxLength - the max length, after which to truncate, or -1 for unlimited
items.translation: maxLength - 截断的最大长度，或为 -1 表示无限制。

items.source: replaceNewlinesAndControlCharacters - whether to replace newline and control characters with placeholders
items.translation: replaceNewlinesAndControlCharacters - 是否将换行符和控制字符替换为占位符

items.source: logger - the logger to use to log the message
items.translation: logger - 用于记录消息的日志记录器

items.source: Mainly for internal use within the framework with Apache Commons Logging.
items.translation: 主要用于框架内部与 Apache Commons Logging 配合使用。

items.source:
Use this to log a message with different levels of detail (or different
messages) at TRACE vs DEBUG log levels.
items.translation: 使用此方法以不同的详细程度（或不同的消息）记录 TRACE 和 DEBUG 日志级别的消息。
